style: Art direction: graphic cel-shading for a post-apocalyptic survival game. Bold dark outlines (near-black #100c0a), hard two-step shadow terminator, flat colour fills, no gradients inside a shape, poster-like contrast. Palette locked to: burnt orange #f49959 and #f9b168, warm deep brown #2f231c and #433a33 and #6a3c26, dusty mid grey-brown #a58b70 and #857d6e and #60584c, sand #caaa83 and #e7c799, bone highlight #f6e6c1. Lit by a single warm key light low and to the left, with a cool bounce fill. Clean readable silhouette that survives being shrunk.
background: Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no gradients, no shadow cast on the background, no text, no numbers, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no ground plane.

sheets.shared: Character turnaround for a game hero: the same single character drawn four times from four angles, consistent proportions, costume and colours in all four. A lone survivor of the 3%: wrapped head and face against the sun, round goggles, a long patched coat over plated shoulders, a climbing harness of straps and pouches, heavy wrapped boots. Stocky readable game proportions, slightly large head and hands so it reads when small. Standing relaxed, arms at sides, full body, feet flat.

sheets.shared: A flat seamless TILEABLE texture swatch seen straight from directly above, perfectly flat with no perspective and no horizon. CRITICAL: the pattern must run all the way to the very edge of the quadrant and be CUT OFF square by it — a full-bleed square swatch. Absolutely NO torn, ragged, rounded or decorative border, NO frame, NO outline around the swatch itself, NO empty margin, NO drop shadow, and nothing may float on a background. The four swatches are four solid squares that touch the thin gutter between them. Features (stones, cracks, tufts) must be distributed evenly with none centred as a focal point, and any feature touching an edge is simply cut by it. Cel-shaded: flat colour areas with hard edges, dark outlines around the larger shapes, no soft gradients.
